description.value: Milton Street Public House is a gastropub occupying a heritage home built in 1892 in Nanaimo's old city quarter, open since 2015. The kitchen emphasizes scratch cooking with local produce, offering an elevated casual menu spanning creative small plates, fresh seafood, flatbreads, and craft cocktails. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo's historic downtown will find a polished sit-down dining experience in a characterful Victorian setting.
